schema.text: When you cycle, how quick are your reflexes if something happens suddenly?
schema.help: Think about how quickly you can react, for example when a car door opens suddenly.

options.text: Not quick at all: I often cannot react in time
A little quick: sometimes I react late
Fairly quick: I usually react in time
Very quick: I almost always react in time
Extremely quick: I always react in time

it.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: Quando vai in bici, quanto sono pronti i tuoi riflessi se succede qualcosa all’improvviso?
it.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: Per niente pronti: spesso non riesco a reagire in tempo
it.#A little quick: sometimes I react late: Poco pronti: a volte reagisco tardi
it.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: Abbastanza pronti: di solito reagisco in tempo
it.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: Molto pronti: reagisco quasi sempre in tempo
it.#Think about how quickly you can react,: Pensa alla rapidità con cui riesci a reagire, per esempio quando una portiera si apre all’improvviso.

fr.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: Lorsque vous faites du vélo, à quel point vos réflexes sont-ils rapides si quelque chose arrive soudainement ?
fr.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: Pas du tout rapides : souvent, je n’arrive pas à réagir à temps
fr.#A little quick: sometimes I react late: Peu rapides : parfois je réagis trop tard
fr.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: Assez rapides : en général je réagis à temps
fr.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: Très rapides : je réagis presque toujours à temps
fr.#Extremely quick: I always react in time: Extrêmement rapides : je réagis toujours à temps
fr.#Think about how quickly you can react,: Pensez à la rapidité avec laquelle vous pouvez réagir, par exemple lorsqu’une portière s’ouvre soudainement.

de.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: Wie schnell sind Ihre Reflexe auf dem Rad, wenn plötzlich etwas passiert?
de.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: Gar nicht schnell: Oft kann ich nicht rechtzeitig reagieren
de.#A little quick: sometimes I react late: Wenig schnell: Manchmal reagiere ich zu spät
de.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: Einigermaßen schnell: Meistens reagiere ich rechtzeitig
de.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: Sehr schnell: Ich reagiere fast immer rechtzeitig
de.#Extremely quick: I always react in time: Äußerst schnell: Ich reagiere immer rechtzeitig
de.#Think about how quickly you can react,: Denken Sie daran, wie schnell Sie reagieren können, zum Beispiel wenn sich plötzlich eine Autotür öffnet.

tr.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: Bisiklet sürerken aniden bir şey olursa refleksleriniz ne kadar hızlıdır?
tr.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: Hiç hızlı değil: Çoğu zaman zamanında tepki veremem
tr.#A little quick: sometimes I react late: Biraz hızlı: Bazen geç tepki veririm
tr.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: Oldukça hızlı: Genellikle zamanında tepki veririm
tr.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: Çok hızlı: Neredeyse her zaman zamanında tepki veririm
tr.#Extremely quick: I always react in time: Son derece hızlı: Her zaman zamanında tepki veririm
tr.#Think about how quickly you can react,: Örneğin bir arabanın kapısı aniden açıldığında ne kadar hızlı tepki verebildiğinizi düşünün.

fa.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری، اگر ناگهان اتفاقی بیفتد، واکنش‌های شما چقدر سریع است؟
fa.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: اصلاً سریع نیست: اغلب نمی‌توانم به‌موقع واکنش نشان دهم
fa.#A little quick: sometimes I react late: کمی سریع: گاهی دیر واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: نسبتاً سریع: معمولاً به‌موقع واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: خیلی سریع: تقریباً همیشه به‌موقع واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Extremely quick: I always react in time: فوق‌العاده سریع: همیشه به‌موقع واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Think about how quickly you can react,: به سرعت واکنش خود فکر کنید؛ برای مثال وقتی درِ خودرویی ناگهان باز می‌شود.

hu.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: Kerékpározás közben milyen gyorsak a reflexei, ha hirtelen történik valami?
hu.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: Egyáltalán nem gyorsak: gyakran nem tudok időben reagálni
hu.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: Nagyon gyorsak: szinte mindig időben reagálok
hu.#Think about how quickly you can react,: Gondoljon arra, milyen gyorsan tud reagálni, például ha hirtelen kinyílik egy autó ajtaja.

ar.#When you cycle, how quick are your refl: عند ركوب الدراجة، ما مدى سرعة ردود فعلك إذا حدث شيء فجأة؟
ar.#Not quick at all: I often cannot react: ليست سريعة على الإطلاق: غالبًا لا أستطيع التصرف في الوقت المناسب
ar.#Fairly quick: I usually react in time: سريعة إلى حد ما: عادةً أتصرف في الوقت المناسب
ar.#Very quick: I almost always react in ti: سريعة جدًا: أتصرف في الوقت المناسب دائمًا تقريبًا
ar.#Extremely quick: I always react in time: سريعة للغاية: أتصرف دائمًا في الوقت المناسب
ar.#Think about how quickly you can react,: فكّر في مدى سرعة استجابتك، مثلًا عندما يُفتح باب سيارة فجأة.
